versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1

- Added an "Example Prompts" section with three sample user scenarios to guide usage.
- Introduced an "Install-First Success Path" walkthrough for quick-start clarity.
- No changes to workflow, boundaries, or audit structure; all additions enhance usability and onboarding.
- Documentation now provides concrete starting points and illustrative examples for new users.

Initial release of ergonomic-bag-pack-check, providing structured bag audits and comfort support for daily carry situations.

- Adds workflow to screen for safety red flags before recommending adjustments.
- Produces a detailed, fillable carry audit with contents inventory, discomfort mapping, and fit checklist.
- Recommends practical, reversible changes such as removing, relocating, or digitizing items.
- Includes weekly reset and one-week test plan to build sustainable, comfortable packing habits.
- Ensures clear boundaries: not for diagnosis or medical treatment, and directs users with severe symptoms to seek professional care.
